why.en: SPF is just a TXT record on the domain. Look at the one for google.com to see how a real domain lists its allowed senders.
why.hinglish: SPF domain par bas ek TXT record hota hai. google.com ka dekho aur samjho ki asli domain apne allowed senders kaise list karta hai.

expect.en: Several TXT strings; look for the one starting with "v=spf1" with include: entries and an ending like ~all or -all. The exact contents change over time.
expect.hinglish: Kai TXT strings; "v=spf1" se shuru hone wali dhoondo jisme include: entries aur ~all ya -all jaisa end hota hai. Exact contents samay ke saath badalte hain.

why.en: DMARC lives at _dmarc.<domain>. It shows the policy (none, quarantine or reject) and the report address.
why.hinglish: DMARC _dmarc.<domain> par rehta hai. Isme policy (none, quarantine ya reject) aur report address dikhta hai.

expect.en: A string like "v=DMARC1; p=reject; rua=mailto:...". The policy value depends on the domain you query.
expect.hinglish: "v=DMARC1; p=reject; rua=mailto:..." jaisi string. Policy value us domain par depend karti hai jise aap query karte ho.

title.en: Look up a DKIM public key

why.en: DKIM keys are TXT records at <selector>._domainkey.<domain>. Google's selector is 20230601 (selectors can change).
why.hinglish: DKIM keys <selector>._domainkey.<domain> par TXT records hoti hain. Google ka selector 20230601 hai (selectors badal sakte hain).

expect.en: A long "v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=..." string split into pieces. If the selector has been rotated you may get no answer; that is normal.
expect.hinglish: Lambi "v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=..." string jo tukdon mein bati hoti hai. Agar selector rotate ho gaya ho to answer nahi aa sakta; ye normal hai.

title.en: Find the DNS TXT lookups in the capture
title.hinglish: Capture mein DNS TXT lookups dhoondo

why.en: Open the lesson's .pcap in Wireshark to see the SPF, DKIM and DMARC queries the MX makes.
why.hinglish: Lesson ka .pcap Wireshark mein kholo aur MX ke SPF, DKIM aur DMARC queries dekho.

expect.en: Three TXT queries and their answers: bank.example, mail2026._domainkey.bank.example and _dmarc.bank.example.
expect.hinglish: Teen TXT queries aur unke answers: bank.example, mail2026._domainkey.bank.example aur _dmarc.bank.example.
